'''Redivus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] who broke out of the [[Belsavis prison]] during a break around [[3641 BBY]]. He was hunted down as part of a bounty by the [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]].
